decisions.reason: Across four experiments testing the Abrams et al. (2008) attentional disengagement effect, the authors report replicating the effect in Experiment 2 (using only the two original postures) while failing to replicate the difference between the lap and screen postures in Experiments 1, 3, and 4 (when additional postures were included), making the aggregated outcome mixed.
